work-ledger.text: Unchecked means outstanding, not authorized completion. Candidate checkpoints are not acceptance stamps. Each completed task needs a candidate and receipt. Tasks are grouped by the child ticket that owns them; a task belongs to exactly one child and is fenced by that child's pull request.
